title: Justice Department Files to Intervene and Dismiss Lawsuit that Would Hamper America’s AI Innovation and Security

reading.body:
A gas turbine power plant operating in Southaven, Mississippi to supply power to an AI data center was operated without required environmental permits and in alleged violation of the Clean Air Act. The deployment proceeded without the regulatory approvals that should have preceded operation in a populated area.

A notice of intent to sue was filed against the facility, with reporting indicating the pollution disproportionately affected nearby Black communities. The failure was regulatory and supervisory, not technical. It would have been caught by standard permitting review and environmental compliance checks before the facility began operations.

Whether the violations occurred as alleged and what remedies are appropriate are not established. Multiple parties have disputed the legal merits of the case.

summary:
# Summary

A notice of intent to sue has been filed against a gas turbine power plant located at 2875 Stanton Road South in Southaven, Mississippi, for alleged violations of the Clean Air Act. The facility powers xAI's Colossus II data center. The document indicates that legal action is being prepared against the power plant operator regarding environmental compliance issues related to air quality standards.

The notice represents a formal step in the legal process before filing a lawsuit, giving the defendant opportunity to address the alleged violations. The specific details regarding the nature of the violations, the plaintiffs involved, and timelines for potential legal action are contained within the full document.
